text:
### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01, A02 and A03 each appeared in every trace (200 of 200); in the later window none of them appears at all (0 of 200). A03 was also the only repeater of the three, averaging about 2.1 occurrences per trace and recurring in about 56 in 100 traces. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003]
- A04 shows the reverse pattern: absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces), it appears in every trace of the later window (200 of 200), always at the final position of the trace. [OCC004, POS004]
- The end of the trace was rewired. Earlier, A05 was always followed by A02, A02 was always immediately followed by A01, and A01 was always the last event. In the later window, A05 is always followed by A04, which is now always the last event. [DIR001, DIR003, POS001, POS004, REL001]
- The repeating part of the trace lost A03. Earlier, A08 was always followed by A03, and each A03 occurrence handed over to A06 (about 53 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) or A07 (about 47 in 100), with A03 and A06/A08 interleaved or repeated in roughly half of the traces. In the later window, A08 leads directly back to A06 (about 46 in 100) or A07 (about 54 in 100), and A03 is no longer observed. [DIR002, DIR004, REL016, REL018]
- A04's new closing role is visible in its relations: it co-occurs with A05 and with A07 in every later trace, always after them (A05 before A04 and A07 before A04 in 100 of 100 traces), whereas earlier it never co-occurred with either. [REL003, REL014, REL019, REL021]
- A06 and A07 now run earlier within traces: A06's median position fell from about 0.16 to 0 and A07's mean position from about 0.48 to 0.30, and typical distances shrank by roughly one position (for example, A06 to A05 was 4 positions apart in all qualifying earlier traces but 3 positions apart in about half of the later ones). [POS006, POS007, LAG001, LAG003]
- Smaller shifts: A06 and A08 each appear in about 51 in 100 later traces versus about 56 in 100 earlier ones, and the remaining relation changes among A05–A08 are 0.05 or less with unremarkable strength (about half of random re-splits produce differences this large). [OCC005, OCC006, REL023, REL025]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a specific restructuring hypothesis: the closing segment and the repetition cycle of the process changed. In the earlier window, every trace ran through the repeating activity A03 — which handed over to A06 or A07 and received the loop-back from A08 — and ended with the fixed sequence A05 → A02 → A01, with A01 as the final event. In the later window, A01, A02 and A03 are no longer executed; A05 leads directly to A04, which closes every trace as the last step, and A08 feeds back into A06/A07 directly, taking over the hand-over to A06/A07 that A03 previously performed. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS004, REL019, REL021]

Because three activities went from universal to unobserved and one went from unobserved to universal — rather than only the shares between persisting paths shifting — this reads as activities being dropped from execution and a new closing step being executed in their place, not as a re-weighting of existing paths. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]

The supporting signs are direct and consistent: the participation flips are maximal on both sides (200 of 200 to 0 of 200 and the reverse), every key item's difference exceeds about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data, the rewiring is observed directly in the successor profiles (A05: A02 → A04; A08: A03 → A06/A07), and the relation items flip coherently with this one story. The earlier positions of A06/A07 and the shorter pairwise distances follow from the same restructuring and are not independent confirmations. [DIR003, DIR004, REL003, REL019, REL021, POS006, POS007, LAG001, LAG003]

Limitations: zero participation establishes only that A01–A03 were not executed in the later sample, not that they were formally removed from the process; and the evidence cannot show whether A04 is a genuinely new closing step or a substitute that absorbed the role of the A02 → A01 tail, since both would produce the same observable pattern. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, DIR003]

Other differences: A06 and A08 participation dipped slightly (about 56 in 100 traces to about 51 in 100, i.e. 111 to 101 traces), a modest difference that sampling variation between two 200-trace windows can still produce; the small relation shifts of at most 0.05 among A05, A06, A07 and A08 are likewise at chance level. [OCC005, OCC006, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027]
